work.name: Furniture & interiors
work.note: Designers Guild, National Furnishers, Salon Français

faq.q: Do you shoot furniture and interiors?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of our biggest categories. We have shot room sets, product films and styled interiors for several furniture and home brands.

faq.q: Can you shoot at our showroom or factory?
faq.a: Yes. We shoot on location in Lahore and across Pakistan, and in Dubai, or we can arrange a studio.

faq.q: Do you also edit footage we already have?
faq.a: Yes. Editing, colour and sound are handled by our sister post production studio, Vesa.

faq.q: How fast can we get content?
faq.a: Social reels can be turned around within days of a shoot. Brand films take longer depending on scale. We agree a timeline before we start.
